items.text: This patch fixes a major issue behind the 'hit reg' woes – shots that could not possibly have missed not actually hitting the target – people have been experiencing.

We're treating this patch as a soft launch of the improvements we're working on, so the patch will only be available on Steam for now. Due to the nature of the issues, they're difficult for us to reproduce; by doing this soft launch we can properly test the impact it has, while also getting it to a large portion of the community as quickly as possible.

Please let us know how this patch feels! In the meantime, we're working on further improvements and fixes related to this. Once we're happy with the results and the feedback you've given us, we'll bring this patch to consoles as well alongside any of the new fixes.
A small patch is now available for Gallipoli that fixes two issues introduced in 2.1.0.
Fixed broken HMG Kit.
Fix for final sector of Anzac Cove.
Before we get into the changelog, we'd like to share a bit more about the ongoing issue most refer to as 'hit reg'.

Sometimes you shoot at centre mass of an enemy from point blank range and your shot doesn't register. Our current leading theory is that this is a desync issue instead of hit registration; we've already reviewed all bullet ballistic code, and did not find an issue there.

Sadly, the issue is hard to reproduce and therefore hard to pinpoint and solve, making the scope significant. We've already spent a ton of time working on this issue, which includes rewriting a significant amount of networking code, reducing possibilities of any kinds of desync.
This update does not fix the desync issue yet, but does introduce some first steps to help identify the case.
We hope to be the bearer of good news in this regard soon. Thank you for your patience!

Hotfix 1.1.1 is now available for PC, applying an initial fix for the Disconnected (CGK) error that could appear when you use the 'Play Now' button to join a match. It may take a few hours before you see benefits.

The hotfix for consoles will follow later. Until this is live, you can still run into the Disconnected (CGK) error on all platforms in rare cases. If you do, try manually joining a match from the list with at least 2-5 open player slots.

The scope of the hotfix has increased significantly this past week. As such we're now considering this Patch 1.1.0, bringing changes to gameplay and balancing in addition to the improvements we mentioned before!
This increase in scope does mean we aren't quite able to get it out in time for the weekend. We didn't want to rush QA stability checks, so we need a bit more time.
In return, here are a couple more things you can expect in this patch:
Increased attacker starting tickets on all maps.
Support for private matches on consoles.
More bayonets for the Ottoman Empire to get them in line with the British Empire.
Melee weapon buff.
Ordered bots to be better team mates.
Downed players appear on the minimap.
...and much more!
Hello everyone!
We hope you’ve been enjoying Gallipoli! It’s been great watching all of you play the game and reading your lovely messages.

The team has been overwhelmed by your feedback on the game (in a good way!), and we’re working on a hotfix that should tackle some common issues. The original plan was to have that out this week, but external issues out of our control forced us to push it to next week.
In order to not leave you in the dark, we wanted to at least share with you today what we’re working on to fix in the immediate future:
Inconsistent hit registering or invincibility.
Random disconnects & connection issues.
Performance issues like crashing and stuttering, especially on consoles.
First person FOV on ultra-wide monitors making weapons appear larger than intended.
Key rebindings not sticking properly.
Room codes to more easily share what match you're in.
Additionally, there are a couple of the things we’re actively looking into or working on, but unlikely to tackle by next week:
Overall weapon balancing – including pistols, but improvements to hit registering should already help here.
Changes to the FOV slider.
Improvements to make it easier to join your friends.
Hello everyone!

Today we'd like to give you a little update for the Ctesiphon & Anzac Cove maps. We've last shown them not long after the initial announcement of Gallipoli, but they have not been gathering dust! While the general lay of the land has not been changed, both maps have received lighting work and changes to weather.

While it may be hard to spot, we've also made balance changes to both maps based on the results from rigorous testing by our QA team and all of you participating in the Closed Playtests. Most of these changes are related to cover, either hard cover like sandbags or visual cover like smoke. We're saving the deep dive into map creation and map balancing for later down the line.
One final thing before we get into the screenshots: the long awaited third episode of our collab with the Royal Armouries and Jonathan Ferguson is here! Grab a brew and put your legs up.
